## Zoning Evaluation — 1218 W George St, Chicago IL
**PIN:** 14291230290000 | **Parcel resolution:** authoritative (city address records)
**Municipal Code current through:** Council Journal of March 18, 2026 — a later amendment may not be reflected.

---

### 1. Zoning District Currently in Effect

This parcel is zoned **RT-4** (Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse & Multi-Unit). This is confirmed by the City's official GIS parcel record, which you can verify on the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).

---

### 2. Is Residential Use Allowed?

**Yes — residential use is the primary permitted use in RT-4.** Allowed residential forms include detached houses, two-flats, townhouses, and multi-unit buildings (3+ units), as well as parks, schools, religious institutions, and home occupations [1] (§17-2-0103).

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards

All figures are from the zoning table for RT-4 (§17-2-0103) and [1] (§17-2-0303):

| Standard | RT-4 Value |
|---|---|
| **FAR** | 1.2 |
| **Max height** | 38 ft |
| **Min lot area per dwelling unit** | 1,000 sq ft |
| **Min lot size** | 1,650 sq ft |

**Lot-area unit yield:** The parcel is 3,075 sq ft ÷ 1,000 sq ft per unit = **3 units maximum by lot area alone** [1]. *Important caveat:* lot area is only one constraint — FAR, height limits, parking, and lot configuration can independently reduce achievable units.
